subject: Hosted API — clarification & next steps after partial availability degradation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@asterionlabs.com>, Asterion Ops <ops@asterionlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API — brief: partial availability signal affecting embedding batch jobs

Hi Olivia / Asterion Ops team,

Wanted to reach out proactively — we observed a partial availability degradation impacting hosted-embedding endpoints in us-west-1 starting ~08:45 PDT. The signal is elevated initiation latency and a small percentage (~0.6%) of batch/async jobs returning 503s. I've attached a short snapshot from our runtime metrics (incident_snapshot_0928.png).

Immediate ask from our side: can you confirm whether you saw any customer-facing errors or queued retries on your side (logs/timestamps would help)? From our telemetry it looks concentrated on long-running, high-token embedding batches rather than single-call inference.

Proposed immediate actions (we'll coordinate on the call if helpful):
- We will toggle a conservative routing fallback (roll back a recent kernel-selection change) at 09:30 to see if it reduces the 503 surface.
- Open a bridged call with your ops and our runtime team at 10:00 PDT to correlate logs if you prefer.
- Draft a short status page entry so your users have visibility — suggested text included below.

Suggested status page blurb (draft):
"We are investigating elevated latencies and intermittent 503s affecting hosted embedding jobs in us-west-1. Some batch embedding requests may fail or retry. Our teams are investigating and will provide updates here. If you rely on long-running batch embeddings, consider temporarily staggering job starts or reducing batch sizes while we stabilize."

We will follow up with a concrete ETA after the first mitigation attempt and will share a customer impact matrix once we correlate logs.

I can join the 10:00 bridge — please advise if you want us to open it.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: incident_snapshot_0928.png (png, telemetry snapshot)

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@asterionlabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Asterion Ops <ops@asterionlabs.com>
Cc: Ian Murray <ian.murray@clocktowertech.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — brief: partial availability signal affecting embedding batch jobs

Hi Sean — thanks for the heads up. We started seeing elevated job failures around 08:50 PDT; most failures are coming from our nightly batch that hits the batch-embed endpoint with ~2k items per job. Error pattern is 503 with a short retry that succeeds ~70% of the time. I’m attaching a small excerpt from our job logs (we'll upload the full bundle to the drive if needed).

Immediate customer impact:
- Nightly batch for production org 'Asterion-Prod' had ~14 failed jobs (out of 210). Failures cause downstream processing delays but are auto-retried.
- We did not see single-call generation errors from our interactive apps.

We’re up for a 10:00 bridge. Our ops will be on the line: ops@asterionlabs.com, I’ll be there as well. If you push a routing rollback, please let us know instantly so we can correlate.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Reliability
Asterion Labs
---
Attachments: asterion_batch_log_excerpt.txt (text, 12 KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@asterionlabs.com>, Asterion Ops <ops@asterionlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — brief: partial availability signal affecting embedding batch jobs

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the log excerpt.

Quick update from runtime: we performed the conservative routing kernel rollback at 09:30 PDT as planned; initial telemetry shows the 503 rate dropped from ~0.6% to ~0.09% and initiation p95 improved by ~220ms. We're keeping the rollback active while we run additional validation. We replaced the newer kernel-selector with the previous version for the affected variant.

Planned next steps (internal + customer-facing):
1) Continue monitoring for one hour. If the 503 rate remains <0.15%, we will keep the rollback and schedule a targeted kernel QA pass before re-introducing the prior selector.
2) Prepare a short status update on our status page (see link) describing the rollback and recommended customer mitigations (stagger batch starts, reduce per-job batch size).
3) Post-incident: produce a root-cause summary and recommended model-serving configuration guidance for Asterion (we'll share a draft in 48 hours).

Attached: customer_impact_matrix.csv — a quick mapping of observable user impact we’ll update after you provide the full logs.

If you prefer, I can post the status update now and flag it as "investigating — mitigation deployed". Otherwise, we can wait until we confirm stability at ~10:40 PDT.

On the bridge at 10:00 — joining now.

Sean
---
Attachments: customer_impact_matrix.csv (csv, template)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@asterionlabs.com>, Asterion Ops <ops@asterionlabs.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Status page entry & post-incident next steps — us-west-1 embedding jobs (resolved -> monitoring)

Forwarding final update for public/status page and for your records — we moved the incident to "Monitoring" at 10:48 PDT after the rollback successfully reduced error rates and latencies.

Status page text (published):
"Resolved — We identified and rolled back a recent kernel-selection routing change which was causing elevated initiation latencies and intermittent 503s for batch embedding jobs in us-west-1. Mitigation was deployed at 09:30 PDT and monitoring shows error rates returned to expected baselines by 10:48 PDT. Impact: a small fraction of large batch embedding jobs experienced transient failures between 08:45–10:48 PDT. If you were impacted, please reference the customer impact matrix we shared or contact support. A fuller post-incident report with root cause and recommendations will be provided within 48 hours."

Action items (owner + ETA):
- Redwood runtime team (Ben Carter): complete kernel selector QA and create canary plan — ETA 2026-10-02
- Customer reliability (Sean Gallagher): deliver draft RCA and tailored guidance for Asterion — ETA 2026-09-30
- Customer (Asterion Ops): upload full job logs to shared drive for correlation — requested by 2026-09-29

Olivia — thanks for the quick collaboration and for getting logs up on the bridge. We'll follow up with the RCA and recommended per-job configuration tweaks (batch sizing guidelines) within the window above. If you need an expedited deep-dive this week, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
